hints.title: Core Idea
hints.text: With words length <= 50, compare all pairs (i, j) with 0 <= i < j < len(words).

hints.title: Key Observation
hints.text: Check if words[j] starts with words[i] and ends with words[i].

hints.title: Algorithmic Steps
hints.text: Increment counter for every satisfying pair.

hints.title: Implementation

variables: L: maximum length of a word
complexity.notes: Direct nested loop prefix and suffix substring verification.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Pairwise comparison easily passes for small n <= 50.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Use built-in prefix and suffix string checks cleanly.
